title: The correlation between the 500 pc scale molecular gas masses and AGN powers for massive elliptical galaxies
question: Is the molecular gas mass within a fixed 500 pc radius of the AGN in cluster-central massive elliptical galaxies correlated with jet power from X-ray cavities, with gas accretion rate and with continuum luminosity, and what is the origin of the mm/submm continuum?

what.value: AGN jet powers P_cav estimated from X-ray cavities

evidence.quote: Jet power from (cite: 2006ApJ...652..216R) and (cite: 2018ApJ...853..177P).
The data of $P_{\rm cav}$ have been taken from the literature (cite: 2006ApJ...652..216R; 2018ApJ...853..177P).
GHz flux from (cite: 1998AJ....115.1693C) except for Centaurus (cite: 1981A&AS...45..367K)
Black hole mass from (cite: 2006ApJ...652..216R) except for NGC 5044 (cite: 2009ApJ...705..624D).
The galaxy redshifts $z$ are those determined by optical observations.

what.value: CO excitation ratios: CO(2-1)/CO(1-0) = 3.2 and CO(3-2)/CO(1-0) = 7.2 in flux density scale

evidence.quote: gives a CO(J=2-1)/CO(J=1-0) line ratio in flux density scale, 3.2
is a CO(J=3-2)/CO(J=1-0) ratio of 7.2 (cite: 2019MNRAS.485..229R; 2019MNRAS.490.3025R)

evidence.quote: which is obtained for massive elliptical galaxies at cluster centers (e.g. (cite: 2019ApJ...879..103F)).

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image the archival CO and continuum data
recipe.method: Calibrate with CASA and the ALMA Pipeline, image with tclean to 3 sigma using Briggs robust 2, subtract continuum with uvcontsub

recipe.goal: Make moment maps of the CO emission
recipe.method: CASA immoments for integrated intensity, velocity centre and velocity dispersion maps

recipe.goal: Extract central 500 pc spectra and fit Gaussian components
recipe.method: Extract spectrum from the central 500 pc region centred on the AGN and fit one or two Gaussian components; ignore features with |v| >~ 500 km/s; for Hydra A exclude the innermost 160 pc and treat east and west separately
key_parameters: Line components kept only if significance > 5 sigma and |v| below about 500 km/s relative to galaxy rest frame

recipe.goal: Derive molecular gas mass within 500 pc
recipe.method: Convert CO integrated intensity to M_mol with the Bolatto et al. relation, correcting higher-J lines to CO(1-0) with F_ul; sum two components when present
key_parameters: F21 = 3.2 (CO(2-1)/CO(1-0)), F32 = 7.2 (CO(3-2)/CO(1-0)) in flux density scale
assumptions: X_CO = 2e20 cm^-2 (K km/s)^-1 (Milky Way value); H0=70, Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7

recipe.goal: Estimate gas accretion rate from turbulent diffusion
recipe.method: Accretion time t_acc ~ r_g^2/nu with diffusion coefficient nu ~ l_t v_t, and accretion rate Mdot ~ M_mol/t_acc, with r_g = 500 pc
key_parameters: v_t = FWHM/2.35, with flux-averaged FWHM when two Gaussian components are present
assumptions: Turbulent angular momentum transport drives accretion regardless of disk-like morphology; derived v_t is an upper limit because rotation may contaminate it

recipe.goal: Correlate M_mol and Mdot with jet power
recipe.method: Pearson correlation on logarithmic scales and BCES (Y|X) power-law fits of log P_cav against log M_mol and log Mdot, with and without Abell 262

recipe.goal: Derive continuum luminosities and compare with M_mol
recipe.method: Measure continuum flux at line-free channels, scale to rest-frame 115.3 GHz with a power law, compute L_con and L_1.4 from NVSS, and test correlation with M_mol
key_parameters: Spectral index gamma = -0.75; eta = 1, ~2, ~3 for CO(1-0), (2-1), (3-2)
assumptions: Continuum is a power law S_nu ~ nu^gamma

recipe.goal: Constrain the origin of the mm/submm continuum
recipe.method: Estimate spectral index from upper and lower sideband fluxes, compare L_con with L_1.4 by BCES, and build a power-law plus modified blackbody SED
